protocol.discrepancy: Exact integer abs(denominator*raw_statistic-numerator) for Fraction null center; positive scaling does not alter ranks.
protocol.calibration: Independent null bank; independent continuous uniform tie variables for every statistic/sample. Reject above kth largest calibration lexicographic pair, k=alpha*(m+1), integer at both nominal levels.
protocol.bank_interpretation: Each rule has exact nominal marginal level over fresh banks/test observations. The fixed bank has a random conditional size; pointwise Wilson intervals assess that conditional size, and Beta(k,m+1-k) quantifies its across-bank variation. No exact equal realized-size assertion.
protocol.pairing: All statistics use the same fields within each model; fresh independent tie variables per statistic and shared across alpha levels preserve nested tests.
protocol.paired_intervals: At least95%pointwise conditional coverage by subtracting endpoints of two97.5%Clopper-Pearson intervals for the discordant probabilities. No simultaneouscoverage or universalpowerordering claim.
protocol.comparisons: Each S window versus NPCR and UACI; S_3x3,S_4x4,S_5x5 versus S_2x2. All contrasts are predefined.
protocol.copying: Each row partitioned into full blocks of2lag. Pair corresponding positions in the first/second halves; independent Bernoulli(theta) per pair replaces recipient difference by donor difference. Incomplete final block untouched. Equivalent difference distribution to copying both independent input-image intensities together.
protocol.partial_identity: Independently replace each difference by zero with probability epsilon; equivalent to setting the second input equal to the first at selected coordinates.
protocol.storage: Save raw integer statistics, calibration/test ties or their fixed seeds, thresholds and rejection counts. Archive source/protocol hashes.
protocol.seed_derivation: SeedSequence([master_seed,geometry_index,phase,stream]); phase0 calibration, phase1 independentnull, phase2+alternative_index for alternatives; stream0 field generation and alternative activation, stream1 tie uniforms. Each group has a tie array (sample_size,stat_count), reused across alpha levels.
